appenzell-schw-galp-toggenburg-classic.title: Appenzell · Schwägalp · Toggenburg Classic
appenzell-schw-galp-toggenburg-classic.slogan: Green hills, cheese villages and a pass that bites back in fog.
appenzell-schw-galp-toggenburg-classic.story: Green hills, cheese villages and a pass that bites back in fog. Out of Rapperswil and back again: 170 km, roughly 3 h 16 in the saddle. The stops in between: Appenzell old town, Toggenburg flow road and Walensee  line. The climb of the day is Schwägalp Säntis road. It tops out at 1,278 m. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 18 km. 498 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 478 m come off over 10 km at around 5.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Appenzell and Schwagalp Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 18 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

legend-nubra-valley-via-khardung-la.slogan: Nubra Valley via Khardung La – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-nubra-valley-via-khardung-la.story: curated scenic road. Ladakh Range, high pass, cold desert. 121 km from Leh to Thang, about 2 h 12 of riding. The highest point is about 5,350 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Leh–Manali Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 10 km this is Leh–Manali Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
